title: Governed async replan provider — durable candidate staging bridges the async Planner Pool to the synchronous RuntimePlanner REPLAN path (isolated feature flag, default OFF)
description: Production Mission Runtime previously failed closed FAIL_CLOSED_REPLAN_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE on every governed REPLAN decision because the LLM Planner Pool is async and the RuntimePlanner contract is sync. This change bridges the two through a NEW durable entity `replan_generation` (contract pair-replan-generation.v1): the sync bridge (wired as ServePlannerDeps.replanProvider under PAIR_ASYNC_REPLAN_PROVIDER=1, default OFF) mints/inspects a deterministic per-(recovery_id, attempt_index) generation row binding mission, recovery decision, superseded plan, failure-context snapshot and attempt index; it throws REPLAN_GENERATION_PENDING (distinct, non-FAIL_CLOSED code) while generation is in flight — MissionRuntime.runReplan treats that code as NOT a failure and consumes NO candidate slot, staying REPLANNING. An async driver (ReplanGenerationService claim/settle/reconcile + makeReplanGenerationDriver sweep, driven from the existing 1s supervisor interval) claims PENDING rows under a bounded lease+deadline (single-flight, restart-safe re-claim, bounded claim count), invokes the SAME runPlannerFailover composition (shared invokePlannerPool seam extracted verbatim from planExpander) with structured replan_context propagated into BOTH planner transports (llmPlan already accepts replanContext; CodexPlannerInvokeConfig gains the field and forwards it to the canonical buildPlannerUserPrompt), and settles the row STAGED or FAILED with typed outcome (PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE/EXHAUSTED/TIMEOUT/ADMISSION_REJECTED/GENERATION_FAILED). The staged candidate re-enters runReplan through the EXISTING synchronous gates — validatePlanProposal + bindPlanExternalInputs + assertPlanDataflow + semantic dedup + ReplanAttemptLedger PREPARED → atomic commit — unchanged. Generation failures map onto the existing FAIL_CLOSED_REPLAN_PROVIDER_* prefix so provider unavailability/timeout/exhaustion/cost-admission rejection keep today's REPLAN-infeasible → fresh-decision semantics. Cost admission reuses service.cost.admitPlannerInvocation with canonical work_open_binding lineage resolution (zero-budget/broken-lineage fail closed before any model invocation). Flag OFF = byte-identical prior behavior.
